display.purpose: The page hook only; two balanced lines.

row-heading.purpose: Names a rail or index; nothing sits above it.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Tiles and cards on the ground.

shadows.name: forward
shadows.purpose: Phone frames on the landing page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a page asks for.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.55 0.24 295)); color: #fff; font: 600 1rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 14px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.24 295); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 295); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(0.29 0.03 300); color: oklch(0.97 0.012 300); font: 600 1rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 14px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.33 0.05 300); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 295); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.html: or plan the whole night
components.css: .ds-link { color: oklch(0.72 0.02 300); font: 500 0.875rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-link:hover { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Phone Frame
components.description: A phone-shaped frame around a live game screen.
components.css: .ds-phone { position: relative; width: 150px; aspect-ratio: 9/18; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2rem; background: oklch(0.21 0.035 300); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 12%); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -24px oklch(0 0 0 / 80%), inset 0 0 0 6px oklch(0.1 0.02 300); } .ds-phone::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 50%; width: 34%; height: 14px; translate: -50%; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.1 0.02 300); } .ds-phone-screen { position: absolute; inset: 6px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 1.6rem; color: oklch(0.97 0.012 300); font: 700 1.125rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Row Heading
components.description: All-caps, tracked wide, alone above its row.
components.css: .ds-row-heading { margin: 0; color: #fff; font: 800 0.875rem/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline stroke, violet ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.22 0.03 300); color: oklch(0.97 0.012 300); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 15%); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: oklch(0.62 0.19 295); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.72 0.02 300); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 295); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Square mark with a violet halo beside the name.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #fff; font: 700 1rem Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: oklch(0.55 0.24 295); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.24 295 / 35%); } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: oklch(0.8 0.12 295); }

narrative.overview:
A living room with the lights down and one phone glowing in the middle of the table. The ground is a near-black violet, faintly grained like paper, and it never competes: the only saturated colour on any surface comes from the games themselves. Everything that is not a game is ink on the dark ground, hairlines, and one violet.

The system is dark-only by use scene, not by category: people play in kitchens, hostels and bars at night, passing a phone around. Type is Geist throughout, pushed to 800 for the few things that need to be loud and left at 400 for everything meant to be read.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black violet ground with a fixed paper grain; no flat paint.
Colour belongs to content (game screens, tiers, decks), never to chrome.
One accent — violet — used for the primary action, the focus ring, and the wordmark, and nowhere decorative.
Geist at two extremes: 800 tracked tight for display, 800 tracked wide and capped for row headings; 400 for body.
Depth is a single, soft, offset shadow plus a hairline; the focused object comes forward and everything else steps back.

rules.name: The Only-Colour-Is-Content Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour appears only inside game screens, tier badges and deck art. Chrome is ink, hairline and one violet.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is spent on the primary action and the focus ring. It is never a background wash, a gradient, or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Heading Stands Alone Rule
rules.body: No label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading. The all-caps row heading is the label; put metadata beneath, never above.

rules.name: The One Thing Forward Rule
rules.body: Depth is spent on the object being shown — a phone frame, a card in play — and never on chrome around it.

dos: Do let game screens supply the colour; keep chrome to ink, hairline and Table Violet.
Do show the product in phone frames rather than describing it.
Do theme the browser: violet selection, caret, accent-colour, scrollbar and focus ring are part of the surface.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion: transitions collapse, scene loops stop, the drawn doodle renders complete.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass as decoration, or zero-blur offset shadows.
Don't put an emoji or a Unicode glyph in the chrome; icons are drawn SVG.
Don't add a label above a heading.
Don't invent evidence — no counts, quotes, logos or press the product cannot show.
